Id.description: Unique identifier of the message thread.

OriginalSender.description: The sender of the original message in the thread.

CreatedUtc.description: Creation date and time of the message thread in UTC timezone in ISO 8601 format.

UpdatedUtc.description: Last update date and time of the message thread in UTC timezone in ISO 8601 format.

IsResolved.description: Whether the message thread is resolved.
